description: Conducting a feasibility study and preparing detailed plans for the extension of the Kelani Valley Railway line beyond Avissawella up to Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 2025 Budget has proposed to extend the existing Kelani Valley Railway Line beyond Avissawella in phases to provide efficient railway services and improve public transport facilities under the modernization of railway transport, and Rs.250 million has been allocated to commence the relevant preliminary works. It has been proposed to reconstruct the said railway line along the previous railway route, and for that purpose, a feasibility study and detailed plans should be expeditiously prepared. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to implement the relevant procurement process to select a consultancy service Entity for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing the United Nations Convention against Cybercrime
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Convention against Cybercrime (UNCC) adopted at the 55th plenary session of the United Nations General Assembly in December 2024, is a global approach designed to address a range of serious cybercrimes. Joining the new Convention will enable Sri Lanka to achieve benefits such as preventing and combating cyber-enabled crimes, strengthening cooperation, recovering assets, protecting witnesses and victims, and developing technical assistance and capacity building. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as Minister of Digital Economy; the Minister of Justice and National Integration; and the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the United Nations Convention against Cybercrime, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of National Planning
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Post of Director General of the Department of National Planning has fallen vacant, due to the retirement of Mrs. J.M.S.D.Rathnayake, who served as the Director General of the said Department, from the public service on 2025‑09‑21. Applications had been called from the Special Grade Officers of the Sri Lanka Planning Service to identify a suitable officer to the said post. Accordingly, based on the recommendations of the Interview Board, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to appoint Mr. K.T.I Premaratne, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, to the post of Director General of the Department of National Planning, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the International Telecommunications Operators Levy (Imposition) Regulations, No.1 of 2020, to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With the imposition of the Regulations published through the Government Gazette in terms of section 22(1) of the Finance Act, No.11 of 2004, the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development is vested with the power to prescribe the rate of International Telecommunications Operators Levy. Accordingly, the International Telecommunications Operators Levy (Imposition) Regulation No.1 of 2010 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1662/1 dated 2010‑07-12, which was last amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2312/80 dated 2023‑01-01, has been further amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification 2430/14 dated 2025‑04-01. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said amended Regulation to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Surveyor General
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. Y.G. Gnanathilaka, who served as the Surveyor General in the Survey Department of Sri Lanka, has retired from the Public Service on 2025-10-01. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to appoint Mr. N.K.U. Rohana, Additional Surveyor General, the most Senior of the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Surveyors Service, to the vacant post of Surveyor General, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs (Amendment) Bill and the Judicature (Amendment) Bill (Prohibition against trafficking of dangerous drugs on high seas) to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑06­‑23 to amend the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, No. 17 of 1929, introducing the provisions on the trafficking of dangerous drugs on the high seas and other consequential amendments, and to amend the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978, to confer the High Court of Sri Lanka the forum jurisdiction to hear and determine criminal prosecutions on indictment for offences committed by any person on the high seas. Accordingly, the relevant Bills have been prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bills. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bills in the Government Gazette and thereafter present those in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a new Act to meet the contemporary requirements by repealing the Post Office Security Fund Ordinance, No.1 of 1931
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted to amend the Post Office Security Fund Ordinance, at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑03‑07. Since it has been proposed to totally amend certain sections of the said Ordinance and to insert new sections, it has been found more appropriate to introduce a new Act to suit the present needs, instead of further amending the said Ordinance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to instruct the Legal Draftsman to repeal the Post Office Security Fund Ordinance No.1 of 1931 (Chapter 282) and prepare a new Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑07‑07, Policy approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 1,900,000 Vials of Meropenem Injection 1g Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of the Meropenem Injection, a drug used to treat a wide range of severe bacterial infections. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement for the supply of 1,900,000 Vials of Meropenem Injection 1g Vial, to United Biotech (Pvt) Ltd, India (Manufacturer: United Biotech (Pvt) Ltd, India), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of USD1.99 million including total cost and freight charges, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the supply of modern printing machinery and equipment to the Department of Government Printing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Government Printing undertakes all confidential and other printing tasks of the Government of Sri Lanka with the assured quality while upholding utmost confidentiality and responsibility while facing competitive open market conditions. However, the Department of Government Printing has to face challenges such as inadequacy of modern printing machinery and equipment, frequent breakdowns in the functionality of machines, involving a high maintenance cost, and high labor utilization. Accordingly, a development project has been planned to be implemented to achieve the objectives of increasing the capacity of printing activities through the purchase and operation of modern printing machinery and equipment, establishing a secure environment for carrying out printing activities, and competing effectively in printing activities with non-government sectors. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said project during the period 2026 – 2030, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Project for Manufacturing of Assistive Devices Locally
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to expand the facilities for manufacturing of assistive devices for differently abled persons locally under the 2025 Budget. Accordingly, Rs.500 million has been allocated for the implementation of a project in the Rheumatology and Rehabilitation Hospital, Ragama and the Sri Lanka National Hospital. This project is expected to be implemented with the components such as upgrading the services of providing assistive devices at the Rheumatology and Rehabilitation Hospital, Ragama and improving the facilities for manufacturing of assistive devices locally under the Accident and Orthopedic Service of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said project using provisions of  Rs.630.2 million within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2025-2027, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-construction of the Kurikadduwan Jetty, Kayts Divisional Secretariat Division of the Jaffna District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Kurikadduwan Jetty serves as the main maritime access point connecting the Jaffna Peninsula with both Nainativu (Nagadeepa) and Delft (Neduntheevu) islands. The jetty facilitates passenger and cargo ferry services to the said islands and serves a wide range of social, religious, economic and administrative functions. The existing jetty has suffered extensive structural damages due to the prolonged exposure to marine conditions and lack of major renovation. Recognizing the importance of the jetty for transportation, religious tourism and regional development, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to implement the Kurikadduwan Jetty construction project under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Project for Rehabilitation and Maintenance of Mitigated Landslides
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Various slope stabilization projects have been implemented so far to mitigate landslide risk situations at identified locations by the National Building Research Organization. Accordingly, approximately 250 slope stabilization projects have been implemented in the past 10 years, and nearly 10 billion Rupees have been spent for the same. The long-term stability of a mitigated landslide depends on the measures taken to manage the subsurface and surface drainage patterns. Without proper maintenance, the failure to manage these drainage patterns can cause previously mitigated locations to become unstable again. Therefore, it is imperative to carry out proper maintenance activities to prevent such instability that may occur at a mitigated landslide site. Although a set of guidelines have been issued by the National Building Research Organization to the relevant stakeholder institutions for this purpose, threats of instability at previously mitigated sites have arisen due to the failure of those institutions to carry out proper maintenance activities. In order to prevent the risks that may arise due to that situation, the recommendation of the Department of National Planning has been received for a project planned by the National Building Research Organization called ‘Rehabilitation and Maintenance of Mitigated Landslides'.  The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to implement the said project during the period 2026 – 2030, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Delineation of Total Impact Zones of Potential Landslides based on Red and Yellow Zone Methodology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the mountainous area, which constitutes about 30% of the total land area of ​​the country spreading over 14 districts, is at risk of landslides. Landslide hazard zonation maps are developed and utilized by the National Building Research Organization as a primary tool for the early identification of landslide-prone slopes of hills and their distribution. Accordingly, landslide hazard zone maps had been prepared covering most of the landslide-prone areas in Sri Lanka by the year 2023. Such zone maps only indicate areas, susceptible for landslide initiations. However, in landslide risk management, it is essential to identify the entire area that may be affected by a landslide, including the landslide initiation zone, debris flow path and depositional areas. Recognizing that situation, the National Building Research Organization has proposed a project titled 'Delineation of Total Impact Zones of Potential Landslides based on Red and Yellow Zone Methodology'. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to implement the said project, taking into account the urgent need to minimize the risk of landslide disasters in the island, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for providing a pair of footwear each for the selected School Students, Lay and Clergy Students of Pirivenas and Seela Mathas for the year 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It has been decided to provide vouchers for obtaining a pair of footwear to the selected school students, lay and clergy students of Pirivenas and Seela Mathas for the year 2026, to the beneficiaries by the end of the school term 2025. It has been planned to securely print those vouchers with a QR code enabling to scan through the Gift Vouchers mobile application developed by the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to grant welfare benefits and provide the same to beneficiary students. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to select students as follows under the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet:

644,000 students studying in schools with less than 250 students across the Island.
53,093 students studying in Estate schools with 251-500 students.
2,300 students in 30 schools where students with special needs are studying.
selected 30,000 lay/clergy students in Pirivenas.

description: Printing of Textbooks/Modules from the State Printing Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025‑06‑16, granted approval to award the contract for printing 40% of the total number of textbooks/modules to be printed for free distribution to school students for the year 2026, to the State Printing Corporation as a direct procurement. The price of the textbooks/modules to be provided to the State Printing Corporation for printing has to be determined based on the lowest evaluated price of the bidder selected under the National Competitive Procurement Methodology for the printing of textbooks/modules. The bidders selected under the National Competitive Procurement Methodology have already been awarded the printing of the relevant textbooks/modules. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to award the contract for printing 6.04 million copies of 78 types of textbooks/modules to the State Printing Corporation for a sum of Rs. 761.29 million (excluding VAT) based on the prices submitted by the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the ‘Sri Lankan Day’ National Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, proposed at the Budget Speech 2025 to hold a National Programme called 'Sri Lankan Day' prioritizing the vision of creating a reconciled Sri Lanka by increasing understanding among the communities. The Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs has been entrusted with the responsibility of implementing the said programme. Accordingly, the 'Sri Lankan Day' programme is planned to be held on 12, 13 and 14 December 2025, in 04 zones viz the Colombo Municipal Council Playground and Viharamahadevi Park, including related premises surrounded by the main roads within that area with the participation of public and private sector. Further, the said programme has been prepared to be held in a manner that represents all ethnicities and religions comprising of programmes that include cultural elements and food cultures of each district, local industry exhibitions and sales, introducing opportunities for innovations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to hold the 'Sri Lankan Day' programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National-Multi-Sectoral Strategic Action Plan on Early Childhood Care and Development 2025-2029
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has already been granted for the implementation of the 'National Policy on Early Childhood Care and Development' to create a conducive environment that supports every Sri Lankan child to achieve their maximum potential. The said National Policy needs to be implemented through a strategic action plan. Accordingly, the 'National Multi-Sectoral Strategic Action Plan on Early Childhood Care and Development 2025-2029' has been prepared with the participation of all stakeholders. It is expected to provide essential services such as health, nutrition, education, social care and protection, with special attention to vulnerable and disadvantaged children through the implementation of the said action plan. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Women and Child Affairs for the implementation of the 'National Multi-Sectoral Strategic Action Plan on Early Childhood Care and Development 2025-2029', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Inclusive Early Childhood Development Programme for Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- In Sri Lanka, the number of children diagnosed with neurodevelopmental disabilities including autism has increased over the past few decades. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement a five-year national programme to improve health, education and service facilities for children with neurodevelopmental disabilities including autism across all 25 Districts to meet the challenges that have emerged. As an initial step, provisions of Rs. 200 million has been allocated through the Budget 2025 to establish a Treatment Centre for children with neurodevelopmental disabilities including autism in accordance with international standards, at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children in Colombo. In addition to the said project, a project proposal has been submitted to the Department of National Planning to extend the interventions for the disease in all 25 Districts. The proposed project consists of the following 03 main components:

Establishment of Child Development and Intervention Centres at District Level.
Establishment of Provincial Level Community Peadiatric Centres.
Implementation of Capacity Building Programmes at District Level.

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the project for the expansion of intervention for children with neurodevelopmental disorders including autism, based on the recommendations made by the Department of National Planning in order to implement the aforesaid project components within the Medium Term Budget Framework 2025-2027, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of the National Building Codes for Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Building codes are a set of regulations including minimum legal and technical requirements relating to planning, construction, maintenance and modification of buildings in a manner that ensures the public safety, health and welfare of the people while minimizing disaster risks. These Codes cover the entire construction sector under various aspects such as structural integrity of buildings, fire safety, electrical systems, plumbing systems, energy efficiency and disaster response capacity. Due to the absence of a National Building Codes currently in force in Sri Lanka, problems have arisen regarding structural safety, quality and regulation of constructions. Taking into consideration the said situation, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2019-04-30 to formulate and establish National Building Codes for Sri Lanka. The World Bank Group has provided the necessary technical assistance to conceptualize the National Building Code by getting relevant stakeholders involved in the development stage of the Building Codes. Further, the formulation of climate-sensitive unified National Building Codes for Sri Lanka has been identified as a priority among the four final recommendations proposed by the Public Investment Management Assessment conducted by the International Monetary Fund in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the National Building Research Organization has prepared a project proposal to formulate National Building Codes for Sri Lanka. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence for the implementation of the said project proposal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of rice known as GR 11/Ponni Samba to address the shortage of Keeri Samba rice in the local market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the Household Income and Expenditure Survey Report of the Department of Census and Statistics, the estimated annual rice consumption in Sri Lanka is 2,460,000 metric tons, of which the annual consumption of Keeri Samba is 10%, i.e. about 246,000 metric tons. The joint proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development, to bring attention to the current shortage of Kiri Samba rice in the domestic market and the sale of Kiri Samba at prices higher than the control price and to exempt from the requirement of obtaining import control licenses to import GR 11/Ponni Samba rice, which is considered a substitute for Kiri Samba rice, from 2025-10-15 to 2025-11-15, subject to a maximum of 520 metric tons per importer, based on the recommendations of the Food Policy and Security Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Financial Intelligence Unit of Sri Lanka and the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Holy See/Vatican City State
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Holy See/Vatican City State on cooperation in exchanging relevant information in combating money laundering, related predicate offences, financing of terrorism and financing of proliferation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to sign the said Agreement between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Republic of Mauritius
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Financial Intelligence Unit of Sri Lanka has been established under the Central Bank of Sri Lanka in terms of the provisions of the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, No. 6 of 2006. It is planned to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the said Financial Intelligence Unit and the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Republic of Mauritius with the aim of providing a framework for sharing information reasonably perceived as relevant for the investigation or prosecution of money laundering, related predicate offences, terrorism financing and proliferation financing. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Domestic Dollar Bonds by the Government of Sri Lanka as a debt instrument
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As the country is currently receiving sufficient foreign exchange and since the liquidity in the domestic foreign exchange market has strengthened, the Government of Sri Lanka has focused on issuing domestic debt instruments denominated in foreign currencies by targeting Sri Lankan commercial banks, providing them with opportunities for foreign currency investments. According to the results of a market survey conducted by the Public Debt Department of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka in August 2025 to determine the consent of the investors, it has been confirmed that investors are interested in investing in various amounts ranging from less than a year to 03 years up to USD 100 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to initiate the activities relating to the issuance of Domestic Dollar Bonds by the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development within the existing legal framework as a short-term liquidity instrument, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Colombo Port City (Guidelines on Grant of Exemptions or Incentives to Businesses of Strategic Importance) Regulations, No.01 of 2025, to Parliament for Approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-07-07 to issue Regulations under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021 to introduce a new incentive mechanism, enabling to implement tax incentives for primary businesses of strategic importance operating within the Colombo Port City, in accordance with the agreements entered into by the Government under the Extended Fund Facility of the International Monetary Fund. Accordingly, the 'Colombo Port City (Guidelines on Grant of Exemptions or Incentives to Businesses of Strategic Importance) Regulations, No.01 of 2025' has been published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2454/62 dated 2025-09-20. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the ''National Mission of the Nation Togethe'' Programme for eradicating Dangerous Drugs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The spread of dangerous drugs has become a national menace in this country and it has also been observed that many crimes are centered around this drug trafficking. It has been identified that the above menace should be eradicated through a national-level programme with national-level political leadership, an efficient decision-making mechanism and broad public participation. Accordingly, a programme called “National Mission of the Nation Together” has been planned to be implemented to achieve the said national objective. Under this programme, it is expected to create awareness among the society on this menace through an extensive publicity process, to break the network associated with drug trafficking, empower rehabilitation opportunities and provide opportunities for those who wish to quit. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to initiate the 'National Mission of the Nation Together” as an urgent and expeditious national programme and to establish a National Steering Committee for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making it mandatory to procure only brown sugar under the food procurements granted by Government institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Pelwatte and Sevanagala factories operating under Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt) Ltd. produce about 56,000 metric tons of brown sugar annually and due to the bountiful harvest of sugarcane cultivation, the brown sugar production this year has exceeded that limit. Accordingly, the attention of the Government has been drawn on the sustainable development of the local brown sugar industry by further popularizing high-quality locally produced brown sugar among the people in this country. Similarly, the need to increase sales opportunities for brown sugar products in the local market in order to protect the employees working in those factories, local sugarcane farmers who depend on this industry, as well as direct and indirect service providers to that manufacturing industry has also been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to make it mandatory to procure only brown sugar when supplying sugar under food procurement for Government institutions such as the Tri-Forces, Sri Lanka Police, Department of Prisons and government hospitals, and to have Lanka Sathosa Limited directly purchase brown sugar from Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt) Ltd. and sell it to consumers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Monaragala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. R.M. Pasan Sri Bandara Rathnayake, who served as the District Secretary/Government Agent in the Administrative District of Monaragala, has retired from the Public Service after service on 2025-08-20. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. A.G. Nishantha, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as an Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, to the vacant post of District Secretary/Government Agent of Monaragala, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Minimum Wage of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.11 of 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers granted approval to increase the National Minimum Wage of private sector employees in parallel with the increase in the salaries of Public Sector employees, in accordance with a 2025 Budget Proposal. Accordingly, the National Minimum Wage of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.11 of 2025, the Budgetary Relief Allowance of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.09 of 2025 and the Budgetary Relief Allowance of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.10 of 2025 have been passed by Parliament on 20250722, to be effective from 2025-04-01. As per the said provisions, the monthly minimum wage will increase from Rs.17,500/- to Rs.27,000/-, with effect from 20250401, and from 2026-01-01, the monthly minimum wage will increase up to Rs.30,000/-. Such increase in the monthly minimum wage should be applicable to all statutory payments such as Employees' Provident Fund, Employers' Trust Fund, overtime, gratuity, maternity benefits and holiday payments. And every employer, including the immediate employer as well as the principal employer, is legally bound to take steps in accordance with the said regulations in respect of the employees engaged in any industry or service through an intermediary or contractor. The Commissioner General of Labour has been authorized to implement the said provisions and steps have already been taken accordingly to inform the relevant parties on the said provisions through newspaper advertisements. This information was brought to the attention of the Cabinet by the Minister of Labour and it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet to take the necessary action to ensure that the said provisions are being implemented in the proper manner.

description: Submission of Radio Frequency Spectrum Auction Regulations to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of Parliament was received on 20240717 to amend the Sri Lanka Telecommunication Act, No.25 of 1991. As per the said amendment, Radio Frequency Spectrum Auction Regulations have to be imposed in terms of the provisions of subsection (7) of section 22 of the said Act. Accordingly, Telecommunication Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka has published the ‘Radio Frequency Spectrum Auction Regulations No.02 of 2024’ through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2397/30 dated 2024-08-14. The proposal made by the Acting Minister of Digital Economy to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Rules pertaining to Excise License Fees for the approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with a Budget Proposal 2025 for amending the guidelines and conditions relating to the issuance of excise licenses, new rules have been formulated relating to excise license fees under the Excise Ordinance, including the annual excise license fee, security deposit fees and one-time industry entry fee. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the rules made under section 32 of the Excise Ordinance to be read with section 25 of the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52), to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Port City has been established as a Special Economic Zone under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021. The Colombo Port City Economic Commission has identified the legal amendments required to achieve the objectives of the Act, such as making the said zone a globally competitive Special Economic Zone, attracting foreign direct investments and strengthening Sri Lanka’s overall global ranking in the ease of doing business. Accordingly, the approval of the Cabinet had been granted on 20240729 for amending the relevant Act, and several new amendments to be made have been identified as of now. Furthermore, since the strategic Business Regulations that granted very important incentives and exemptions to investors in the Port City have been repealed with effect from 20250804, the proposed new provisions are also expected to directly address the problems of those investors. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, incorporating the newly identified amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the product filling facilities at Zone 7 at the Kolonnawa Installation of Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminals Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Board of Directors of Ceylon Petroleum Terminal Company Limited has approved the development of the product filling facilities in Zone 7 at the Kolonnawa Terminal of Ceylon Petroleum Terminal Company Limited under 03 phases. The Department of National Planning has recommended the implementation of the proposed project. It has been estimated that, the cost for the total design of the state-of-the-art filling facilities for petrol, diesel and kerosene in Zone 7 at the Kolonnawa Terminal and construction of the Gasoline Filling facility Phase -1 at the said zone, as Rs.1.455 million + taxes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to implement Phase- 1 of the project of the Development of the product filling facilities at Zone 7 at the Kolonnawa Terminal and to commence the procurement process for the said project as an Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning contract, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of 448,000 IU Human Growth Hormone or Somatropin for Injection BP/USP/IP
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Human Growth Hormone or Somatropin drug is used to treat growth failure in children and adults who lack natural growth hormone, and international competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of 448,000 IU of the said drug. Two (02) bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement, to A Baur & Co. (Pvt) Ltd., Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: Merk Serono SPA, Italy), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, based on the recommendations of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, for a total cost of Rs. 860.50 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of 24,000 Vials of Infiximab Injection of 100mg Powder
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Infliximab Injection is used to reduce the symptoms of Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as to treat certain types of arthritis. International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 24,000 vials of the said vaccine powder, and two (02) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to Celltrion Inc of the Republic of Korea (Manufacturer: CELLTRION Inc, Republic of Korea), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a total cost of US$ 03 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of 500,000 Rolls of Soft Cloth Liner Tape 10cm x 10cm
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the supply of 500,000 rolls of Soft Cloth Liner Tape 10cm x 10m for the protection of dressing, tubing and medical devices. Five bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement, to George Steuart Health (Pvt) Ltd., Sri Lanka, (Manufacturer: Precision Coatings Pvt. Ltd., India), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a total cost of Rs.270.56 million (excluding VAT), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 218,000 Colistimethate Sodium Injection 1,000,000 IU Vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Colistimethate is an antibiotic used to treat severe infections caused by susceptible strains of certain gram-negative bacteria. In view of the need for the said drug, international competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of 218,000 vials of colistimethate sodium vaccine 1,000,000 IU and six (06) bids have been received for the same. Taking into account the recommendations made by the Procurement Appeal Board pertaining to the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee regarding the relevant bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to M/s Ceyoka (Pvt) Ltd. of Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: Ciron Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd., India) for a total cost of Rs. 32.48 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 1,600,000 Prefilled Syringes of Epoetin Injection 4,000IU
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 1,600,000 Epoetin Prefilled Syringes 4,000 IU used for the treatment of kidney patients. Four (04) bids have been received for the same. Taking into account the recommendations made by the Procurement Appeal Board pertaining to the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee regarding the relevant bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to M/s Reliance Life Sciences (Pvt) Ltd. of India for a sum of US$ 1.414 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 650,000 Prefilled Syringe of Epoetin Injection 4,000IU
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Epoetin injection is a drug used in the treatment of kidney patients. International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 650,000 pre-filled said syringes of 4,000 IU, and four (04) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Procurement Appeal Board regarding the relevant bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement, to M/s Reliance Life Sciences (Pvt) Ltd. of India, the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of US$ 574,600, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a study in order to obtain permanent solutions for the issues arisen after construction of the Salinity barrier across the Matara Nilwala River
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Nilwala River is the main water source which supplies drinking water to several major cities including Matara City and the people residing in the Beliatta and Tangalle Divisional Secretariat Divisions of the Hambantota District. With the erosion of the bed level of the Nilwala River below sea level, salt water inflows to the pumping stations during dry seasons severely disrupting the supply of drinking water. As a solution to this issue, a structure of salinity barrier with 05 gates has been constructed during the period of 2018 and 2022. It has been revealed that due to the construction of the said structure of salinity barrier, the flow of water in the river is obstructed not only during flood situations but also during dry seasons, causing waterlogging of cultivated lands and hindering farming. Although studies have been conducted in this regard by the Hydrological and Disaster Management Division of the Irrigation Department and the Lanka Hydraulic Institute, it has not been possible to provide a sustainable solution for the issue so far. At a meeting held in this regard on 202509-08, under the chairmanship of the Secretary to the President, with the participation of all relevant parties, it has been decided to obtain a report from an independent institution representing qualified professionals in the engineering field. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to have a study conducted for a sustainable solution to the problems that have arisen after the construction of the Matara Nilwala Salt Barrier from the Institute of Engineers Sri Lanka which is an institution in the type referred to above, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 15,000 MT of Urea (Prilled) to State Fertilizer Company Limited to release to the market as direct and mixed fertilizer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-05-26, granted approval for 15,000 MT of Urea fertilizer to be procured by State Fertilizer Company Limited under the international competitive bidding procedure so as to release to the market as direct and mixed fertilizer required for farmers for paddy cultivation. Accordingly, international competitive bids have been invited and 03 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to award the contract for the supply of 15,000+/-5% MT of Urea to M/s Valency International Pte. Ltd, Singapore for a sum of USD 6.9 million, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee pertaining to the aforesaid bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the purchase of a Revenue Administration System for the Excise Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2024-05-22, granted approval for the commencement of procurement activities to establish a fully digital, integrated Information and Communication Technology based Revenue Administration System for the Excise Department. The said system is expected to enable seamless exchange of data, risk management, revenue reconciliation, enhanced transparency and accountability. Bids have been invited for the procurement of the said Revenue Administration System following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure under the Single Stage Two Envelope method. The Standing High Level Procurement Committee has recommended the award of the relevant contract to Millennium I.T.E.S.P (Pvt) Ltd. and Metropolitan Technologies (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.1,310.94 million (excluding tax). Three (3) appeals have been submitted to the Procurement Appeal Board regarding the said procurement, and the said appeals have been dismissed by the Procurement Appeal Board. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the procurement for the design, development, implementation and maintenance of a Revenue Administration System for the Excise Department, to Millennium I.T.E.S.P (Pvt) Ltd. and Metropolitan Technologies (Pvt) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fulfilling National Obligations in line with the Kigali Amendment to the Montreal Protocol for limiting Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) chemicals in a phased out manner
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In 2018, Sri Lanka has ratified the Kigali Amendment to the Montreal Protocol for limiting HFCs chemicals in a phased out manner. According to this amendment, developing countries with non-high ambient temperature that do not produce HFCs chemicals must commence limiting HFCs chemicals in a phased out manner in 2024 and achieve an 80% reduction by 2045. Furthermore, the use of those chemicals has been controlled through a quota system since 2024-01-01. The relevant chemicals imported into Sri Lanka are used as refrigerants in the Refrigeration, Air Conditioning and Mobile Air Conditioning sectors and for several applications in various sectors including agriculture, fisheries, healthcare, tourism, transportation, industries, housing and construction. Therefore, new regulations should be imposed on the relevant imports, taking into account the sustainability and cost-effectiveness of local industries. Further, it has also been identified that it is essential to introduce new policies and laws and regulations regarding the imposition of restrictions on the re-export of the said imported chemicals and the use of all imported quantities only for domestic consumption. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to take necessary action to impose the necessary policies and laws and regulations to control the import into Sri Lanka, export or re-export from Sri Lanka of pure hydrofluorocarbon substances and all mixtures containing such chemicals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for empowering families belonging to poor and extremely poor categories receiving benefits under the Aswesuma Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The responsibility of empowering 1.2 million families belonging to poor and extremely poor categories currently receiving benefits under the Aswesuma Welfare Benefit Scheme has been entrusted with Department of Samurdhi Development. Under the said Aswesuma Beneficiary Empowerment Programme, two pilot projects are being implemented with the financial and technical assistance of the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank in the selected Divisional Secretariat Divisions and Grama Niladhari Divisions. The pilot projects envisage providing a financial grant of up to Rs.150,000 to a poor and extremely poor family unit identified according to the methodology of those pilot projects based on their business or employment plan and after entering into agreements with them. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to provide the proposed financial grant to 23,775 beneficiary families selected from among the families residing in 839 Grama Niladhari Divisions in 143 Divisional Secretariat Divisions in all Districts under the said pilot programme in order to improve their livelihoods within the time frame from 2025 to 2027, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing a Common Logo and Establishment of a ‘Scheme Owner’ for Sri Lanka Good Agricultural Practices (SL GAP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 'Sri Lanka Good Agricultural Practices' (SL GAP) Programme was introduced by the Department of Agriculture in 2015. Through this programme, it is expected to promote food security, ensuring the sale of agro production of commercial farmers and enhance environmental sustainability through utilization of agro chemicals and other agricultural inputs in crop production at a minimum level and obtain a quality and healthy harvest. Since the authority of the Logo currently used for the SL GAP programme is vested with the Director General of Agriculture in accordance with the provisions of the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003, the name 'Department of Agriculture' is also used with that logo. The SL GAP programme needs to be expanded to cover all agricultural crops, and instead of various Ministries, Departments and Institutions using the SL GAP Logo in different ways for each crop and implementing the said programme using separate Scheme Owners, it has been identified that it would be more advantageous in Global Certification to establish a General Scheme Owner under a Common Logo unique to Sri Lanka and implement the programme.  Accordingly, the joint proposals made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation and the Minister of Plantations and Community Infrastructure to introduce one Common Logo, appoint the Secretary to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation as Scheme Owner and establish authorized Sub Units to implement the SL GAP programme under other relevant Ministries and Institutions, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transferring the block of land where the Faculty of Visual Arts of the University of the Visual and Performing Arts is located, to the University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Faculty of Visual Arts of the University of Visual and Performing Arts is located on the Government land at No.46, Horton Place, Colombo 07, belonging to Kurunduwatta Grama Niladhari Division of Thimbirigasyaya Divisional Secretariat Division in the Colombo District. The University of Visual and Performing Arts should have the legal title to the land on which the Faculty is located in order to provide adequate physical facilities for the development of practical and academic skills of the approximately 643 students studying in the Faculty of Visual Arts. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to transfer the state-owned block of land in extent of 0.6277 hectare currently occupied by the Faculty of Visual Arts, to the University of Visual and Performing Arts as a free Grant in terms of section 6(1) of the State Land Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting a block of land for the construction of a student hostel for the Faculty of Medicine of the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Students of the Faculty of Medicine of the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka, established in Kuliyapitiya, carry out their hospitalbased training at the Kurunegala Teaching Hospital. Since the Wayamba University does not have a hostel in the vicinity of the Kurunegala Teaching Hospital to provide hostel facilities to the Medical Students belonging to 03 academic groups, those students have to arrange residential facilities by themselves. Therefore, construction of a hostel in a safe place where those students can have easy access to the Kurunegala Teaching Hospital during the day and night has become a prime requirement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to vest a state-owned block of land in extent of 80 perches located in the Kurunegala West Grama Niladhari Division of the Kurunegala Divisional Secretariat Division, which has been identified for the construction of the said hostel, with the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka as a free Grant under section 6(1) of the State Land Ordnance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to a Post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. H.C.D.L Silva, who served as a Deputy Secretary the Treasury, retired from the Public Service with effect from 2025‑10‑06 upon the completion of 60 years of age. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint Mr. A.N. Hapugala, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Accountants’ Service, presently serving as the Director General of the Department of Treasury Operations, to the said vacant Post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of Officers and Employees to the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption on temporary basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption has been given a higher level of independence by the Anti-Corruption Act, No.9 of 2023 and the said Act contains provisions for the appointment of a dedicated staff by the Commission. The Anti-Corruption Act also includes provisions for the appointment of any officer or employee of the Public Service, Provincial Public Service, Audit Service and State Corporation, to the Commission on a temporary basis. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to take necessary action to appoint suitable officers from among the officers serving in the Public Service, Police Service, Audit Service, Provincial Public Service as well as State Corporations on temporary basis in accordance with the provisions of subsections 26(4), 26(5), 26(6), 26(8) and 26(9) of the Anti-Corruption Act, in order to carry out the activities of the Commission efficiently until the permanent staff for the Commission is appointed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Financial Subsidy for fertilizer for farmers cultivating paddy lands during the Maha Season 2025/26
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Rs.33,500 million has been allocated for the year 2025 for providing the financial subsidy for fertilizer and it has been estimated that additional provisions of Rs.05 billion will be required to grant the financial subsidy for fertilizer taking into consideration the total extent of lands of paddy and other field crops estimated to be cultivated for the Maha Season 2025/26.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to secure additional provisions of Rs.05 billion for the payment of financial subsidy for fertilizer based on the recommendation of the Food Policy and Security Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Wildlife Office at the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport, Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The occasional entry of wild animals such as wild elephants into the premises of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport in Hambantota and movement across its access roads have frequently caused damages to the infrastructure facilities of the Airport, and its operations have also been affected. It has also been identified that the cost incurred by Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited to repair such damages caused to the infrastructure is significantly high. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to establish a dedicated Wildlife Office at the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport in Hambantota enabling to ensure the safety of passengers, airport staff and airport infrastructure by identifying and properly managing such wildlife threats in advance, and to maintain uninterrupted air services while minimizing possible delays and disruptions in airport operations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Term Contract for the procurement of four (04) shipments of Murban Crude Oil during the period from 2026‑01‑01 to 2026‑04-30
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation for the purchase of 04 shipments of Murban crude oil for a period of four (04) months from 2026-01-01 to 2026-04-30, under two options: payment prior to the date of Quantity Drawn (100% Ex. Storage Modality) and thirty days credit (L/C) opened through the Bank of Ceylon. Six (06) bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the relevant procurement, to M/s BB Energy Asia Pte. Ltd., Singapore, based on the recommendation made by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee after evaluating the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for supplying food items to the Department of Prisons for the Year 2025/26
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Prisons has invited bids to select suppliers for the supply of food items under 11 food categories for 31 prison institutions for the year 2025/26. Based on the recommendations made by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating 945 bids received accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to award contracts for the supply of food items to the Department of Prisons for the year 2025/26 to the selected suppliers for a total cost of Rs.4,317 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 40,000 Vials of Liposomal form of Amphotericin B 50 mg Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 40,000 vials of the above-mentioned vaccine, which is used to treat life‑threatening fungal infections, including cryptococcal meningitis and visceral leishmaniasis, particularly in people with compromised immune systems. Four (04) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee regarding the relevant bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to Bharat Serums and Vaccines Limited, India (Manufacturer: Bharat Serums and Vaccines Limited., India), the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, for a total cost of US$680,000.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 400,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution BP/USP/Ph Eur 20% in 50ml Bottle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 400,000 bottles of 50ml of the above-mentioned vaccine, which is used to treat the hypovolemia (low blood volume) and low albumin levels in the blood and in patients with kidney failure and liver disease. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee regarding the 03 bids received accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement to TAKEDA PHARMACEUTICALS INTERNATIONAL AG (Part of Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited), Switzerland (Manufacturer: TAKEDA Manufacturing Austria AG, Austria), the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, for a total cost of USD9.16 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 28,000 vials of Trastuzumab Injection 440mg in 20ml vial (with solvent)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of Trastuzumab Injection, which is used to treat certain types of cancers. Five bids have been received for the purpose. Based on the recommendation made by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee regarding the relevant bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to Cliniqon Biotech (Pvt) Ltd., Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: AryoGen Pharmed, Iran), the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, for a total cost of Rs.516.6 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for Providing New Houses to the Plantation Community who have lost their Homes due to Natural Disasters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The ‘Programme to Provide New Houses to Plantation Communities who have lost their Homes due to Natural Disasters’ has been launched in the year 2025 with the aim of relocating around 3,250 plantation families who have been residing in temporary houses over a long period of time due to natural disasters, to safe settlements under a multi-phased plan. The said programme is expected to be implemented between the period of 2025 - 2027, and it has been planned to construct 1,400 new housing units and settle the beneficiary families during that period. The total cost of the programme is Rs. 4,500 million, and a provision amounting to Rs. 1,300 million has been allocated for the year 2025. Currently, houses are being constructed for 495 eligible beneficiary plantation families in the districts of Badulla, Kegalle, Nuwara Eliya, Ratnapura, Kandy, Matale, Colombo, Kalutara, Matara and Monaragala under the said programme. The Ministry of Plantation and Community Infrastructure is currently taking steps to secure foreign aid for the construction of houses for the remaining families which are not covered under this programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure to implement the programme to provide new houses for the plantation communities who have lost their homes due to natural disasters until 2027‑12‑31 and to secure provisions required for the purpose within the medium-term budgetary framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Airport Facility Complex at the Colombo International Airport, Ratmalana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2019‑09‑17 to initiate the procurement process for the construction of an Airport Facility Complex at the Colombo International Airport, Ratmalana. Accordingly, bids were invited under the National Competitive bidding method and nine bidders have submitted their bids. Based on the recommendations made by the relevant Bid Evaluation Committee and the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, after evaluating the said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation, to award the relevant contract to Sanken Construction (Private) Limited, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, for a sum of Rs.3,046.29 million (without VAT), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Standards Institution and the Federal Agency on Technical Regulating and Metrology of the Russian Federation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Federal Agency on Technical Regulating and Metrology of the Russian Federation, an institution at highly advanced status in the field of metrology and instrument calibration, has over 39,000 national standards. The Sri Lanka Standards Institution has only about 4,500 national standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Standards Institute and the Federal Agency on Technical Regulating and Metrology of the Russian Federation with the objectives of using the standards currently used in Russia for future standards to be developed in Sri Lanka, removing technical barriers with the Russian Federation in facilitating trade by harmonizing standards between the two countries, obtaining advanced technical cooperation to the Sri Lanka Standards Institute in the fields of metrology and calibration, and developing cooperation on standardization in accordance with international law, guidelines and standards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Master Plan for Western Province Municipal Solid Waste Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Like many developing countries, urban solid waste management in Sri Lanka is also facing many challenges and difficulties. In order to address this situation more effectively, attention has been paid on the preparation of a Master Plan for solid waste management in order to collect, treat and dispose the relevant municipal solid waste in a safe, sustainable and environmentally friendly manner. Accordingly, taking into account the National Waste Management Policy approved by the Cabinet on 2019-10-01, a project to prepare a Master Plan for the Western Province Municipal Solid Waste Management has been implemented through a Memorandum of Understanding signed between the Japan International Cooperation Agency and the Government of Sri Lanka. The said Master Plan has been prepared through the said Project in coordination with all the stakeholders. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to implement the Master Plan for the Western Province Municipal Solid Waste Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the concession on Embarkation Levy for Mattala Rajapaksha International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per a decision taken by the Cabinet on 2025-01-06, Airlines operating scheduled flights to and from Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport have been exempted from the Embarkation Levy. Under the said tax concession, some Airlines have already operated scheduled international flights to and from the said Airport, and some Airlines have expressed their intention to operate flights to the said Airport. It is expected that the continuation of the said concession on Embarkation Levy will enable attracting new scheduled international Airlines to the said Airport and continuation of the existing international flight operations by increasing competitiveness. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to further extend the current period of the concession on Embarkation Levy until 2027-06-26, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultations between Sri Lanka and the Republic of Malta
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and the Republic of Malta, as island nations and members of the Commonwealth of Nations, have collaborated in multilateral forums on issues of mutual concern, including maritime affairs, climate change and sustainable development. This year also marks the 25th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Tourism of the Republic of Malta to promote and strengthen bilateral relations in the political, economic, trade, investment, consular and cultural aspects, as well as to exchange views on regional and international matters of mutual interest, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Institutionalizing the Results - based Management in the Public Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Based on the policies and objectives of the present Government, the Department of Project Management and Monitoring of the General Treasury has prepared 'Ministerial Results Frameworks' for the period 2025-2029 for 22 Line Ministries and institutions falling thereunder in order to institutionalize results-based management in the Public Sector. The Ministerial Results Frameworks will help in timely achievement of development goals within the respective scope in line with the hierarchical responsibilities of each Ministry, thereby ensuring the timely delivery of the desired outputs and benefits to the people, strengthening the linkages between economic sectors, and enhancing public confidence in public investments. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to institutionalize Results-based Management in the Public Sector and to integrate the Ministerial Results Frameworks into the Annual Action Plans of each Ministry and the strategic phases of the budget process, and to take necessary steps to achieve the desired goals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: නව ක්ෂුද්‍ර මූල්‍ය හා ණය නියාමන අධිකාරිය පනත් කෙටුම්පත
decision_details_title: 2025-09-22 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය (මීලග රැස්වීමේදී සම්මත කිරීමට යටත්ව)
decision_details_body: - ශ්‍රී ලංකාව තුළ ක්ෂුද්‍ර මූල්‍ය කර්මාන්තය සඳහා පුළුල් නියාමන රාමුවක් ස්ථාපිත කිරීම උදෙසා 2016 අංක 6 දරන ක්ෂුද්‍රමූල්‍ය පනතේ ප්‍රතිපාදන ප්‍රමාණවත් නොවීම හේතුවෙන් නව ක්ෂුද්‍ර මූල්‍ය හා ණය නියාමන අධිකාරිය පනත හඳුන්වා දීම පිණිස මීට පෙර අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල අනුමැතිය ලබා දී තිබේ. ඒ අනුව, සකස් කරන ලද පනත් කෙටුම්පත රජයේ ගැසට් පත්‍රයේ පළ කිරීමෙන් අනතුරුව එම පනත් කෙටුම්පතට එරෙහිව විවිධ පාර්ශ්වයන් විසින් ශ්‍රේෂ්ඨාධිකරණයේ පෙත්සම් 07ක් ගොනු කර ඇත. එම පෙත්සම් සම්බන්ධයෙන් ශ්‍රේෂ්ඨාධිකරණය විසින් ලබා දී ඇති තීරණය හා පාර්ලිමේන්තුවේ 'ආර්ථික අර්බුදය බලපෑම සමනය කිරීම පිළිබඳ ආංශික අධීක්ෂණ කාරක සභාව' විසින් ලබා දෙන ලද මඟ පෙන්වීම ද සැලකිල්ලට ගනිමින් නව පනත් කෙටුම්පතක් සකස් කිරීමට මුදල්, ක්‍රමසම්පාදන සහ ආර්ථික සංවර්ධන අමාත්‍යාංශය සහ ශ්‍රී ලංකා මහ බැංකුව විසින් අවධානය යොමු කර තිබේ. ඒ අනුව, නව ක්ෂුද්‍ර මූල්‍ය හා ණය නියාමන අධිකාරිය පනත හඳුන්වා දීම සඳහා 2025-08-11 දින පැවැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල රැස්වීමේ දී අනුමැතිය ලබා දී ඇත. නීති කෙටුම්පත් සම්පාදක විසින් සකස් කරන ලද නව පනත් කෙටුම්පත සඳහා නීතිපතිගේ නිෂ්කාශනය ලැබී තිබේ. එකී ක්ෂුද්‍ර මූල්‍ය හා ණය නියාමන අධිකාරිය පනත් කෙටුම්පත රජයේ ගැසට් පත්‍රයේ පළ කිරීමටත්, ඉන් අනතුරුව අනුමැතිය සඳහා පාර්ලිමේන්තුවට ඉදිරිපත් කිරීමටත්  මුදල්, ක්‍රමසම්පාදන සහ ආර්ථික සංවර්ධන අමාත්‍ය වශයෙන් ගරු ජනාධිපතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: New Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-09-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has previously been granted to introduce a new Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority Act, since the provisions in the Microfinance Act No, 6 of 2016 are inadequate to establish a comprehensive regulatory framework for microfinance industry in Sri Lanka. Subsequent to the publication of the Bill prepared accordingly in the Government Gazette, 07 petitions had been filed in the Supreme Court by various parties against the said Bill. Taking into account the determination delivered by the Supreme Court on the said petitions and the guidance of the Parliamentary ‘Sectoral Oversight Committee on Mitigating the Impact of the Economic Crisis’, the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka have paid their attention towards the formulation of a new Bill. Accordingly, the Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025 08 11, granted approval to introduce a new Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority Act. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The Proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ආයතනික රැකවරණය හෝ භාරකාරත්වය යටතේ වන ළමුන් සහ වීදි ළමුන් සඳහා ජීවන වියදම් දීමනාවක් ලබා දීමේ වැඩසටහන
